product.olivetti-m4-34.summary: The M4 with a 40 MHz 386SX and integrated VGA.
product.olivetti-m4-34.history: Olivetti identified the M4-34 as a 386SX AT system in its M4 range. Its design put the VGA controller and starting memory on the BA2012 motherboard.
product.olivetti-m4-34.architecture: Graphics could be upgraded by adding video memory. Olivetti documents the 512 KB VGA-MEM/02 kit and BIOS revisions specific to 80 ns VRAM.
product.olivetti-m4-34.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records BA2012 · Rev. 1.01–1.05.
product.olivetti-m4-34.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m4-34.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m4-34.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, §38, pp. 38-1–38-3.
